name: pxlogic-logic2-bridge
description: Standalone PXLogic live capture bridge for Saleae Logic 2

scripts.tauri: pnpm --dir tools/logic2-bridge/tauri-client run prepare:payload && pnpm --dir tools/logic2-bridge/tauri-client exec tauri
scripts.check: pnpm --dir tools/logic2-bridge run check && pnpm --dir tools/logic2-bridge/tauri-client run check
scripts.test: pnpm --dir tools/logic2-bridge test && pnpm --dir tools/logic2-bridge/tauri-client test
